method: Actual independent Steam scale-load/multiplication consumers plus Native corresponding complete object-render data/control flow and resolved vector GOT relocation. No adjacency/name/byte-vote/absence closure; no.arch or game execution.

rows.structural_correspondence: Old4aed70 ObjectParticleDraw applies the selected default unit-axis coefficient to the particle size, or size times reciprocal instance field8 when field30 is nonzero, before matrix scale/translation in both emitter-transform branches. Actual Native36ad00 is the complete corresponding kind3 object-particle draw: emitter+68, count+8, particles+20,58-byte float-age samples,18-byte object records, per-particle RGBA/palette modulation, angularVelocity*age+half*ageSquared*instanceAcceleration, optional base transform, scale/translation and actual native model-render submission. Both branches multiply their selected size by three scalar fields of the vector reached through GOT8817e0; exact R_AARCH64_RELATIVE relocation maps that pointer to86fac4, whose three floats are1,1,1. Independently, actual ordinary Steam.shared581900..58193a tests instance field30, loads sample size at+10, optionally multiplies its reciprocal factor, then multiplies the three axis values from AD9970/AD9974/AD9978 at58191c/581932/58192a. This typed control/data flow proves actual Steam XYZ coefficient correspondence; identical vector bytes are only corroboration. AD9990 is a different four-component color/default vector and is explicitly rejected as this source. Golden native model/RHI ownership differs from old RpClump rendering.
required_seams: object-particle-unit-scale:bind exact Golden XYZ1.0 coefficient fields AD9970/+4/+8 (Native86fac4/+4/+8) in both transformed and untransformed size/reciprocal-scale branches and every old4aed70 alias

object-particle-unit-scale:replace complete old RpClump transform/color/draw path with actual native float-age58-byte samples,18-byte object records, emitter flags, acceleration/rotation/matrix and model/RHI lifetime/queue protocol; do not retain PS2 callbacks or merely change scale data
rows.tail_policy: The selected Z row has4 live bytes plus4 inert PS2 zero alignment; never source the adjacent native dispatch-table pointer as a fourth vector lane.
